example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এত ঢ্যাঙা যে সবার থেকে আলাদা লাগে।
ঢ্যাঙা ছেলেটি দৌড়াতে গিয়ে হোঁচট খেয়ে পড়ল।
example_sentences_in_english: He is so lanky that he stands out from everyone.
The gangly boy tripped while running.
history: Originates from the imagery of tall, slender palm trees (তালগাছ) common in rural Bengal, symbolizing disproportionate height.
note: Often used to describe someone tall but not proportionally built, evoking rural landscapes.
